description: Internal telemetry message: mapped readings of one device from one source packet, published by runtime ingestion on iot.telemetry.device (stream IOT_DEVICE_TELEMETRY, Nats-Msg-Id = uuid, a random UUID per packet). Producer and consumer: the runtime (devices-storage). At least once; storage deduplicates by uuid in device_runtime.telemetry_outbox. Fences: generation and definition.configuration_uuid against the active definition. Not read by Laravel.

capture_id.description: Present while a telemetry capture records the source packet; storage reports the outcome to that capture.

generation.description: The device deployment generation the runtime ingested under; storage drops the message unless the device is still active at this generation.

definition.description: The runtime's copy of the active device configuration, re-encoded from Go. It omits a mapping's ingress_conversion when that is null.

installation_uuid.description: Adapter devices only: the enrolled installation, copied from the definition's adapter binding when the metric's provenance matches it.

adapter_revision_uuid.description: Adapter devices only: the adapter revision the managed publisher reported in the metric's properties.

manufacturer_serial.description: Adapter devices only: copied from the definition's adapter binding.

last_valid_received_at.description: Part of the runtime's reading shape, set on stored latest values when a reading is not good; ingestion does not set it today.

counter_event.description: Set when a monotonic counter fell below its previous value: a rollover when the profile's rollover point explains it, otherwise a reset. The reading stays good and starts a new segment.
